description_for_human: Universal browser-based database manager and visual ER diagram designer for SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare D1.
description_for_model: Neon DB Admin is a static PWA database management workbench hosted on GitHub Pages that runs SQLite locally via WebAssembly (sql.js) and connects to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1, and LibSQL via CORS-enabled Cloudflare Workers, PHP PDO (proxy.php), or Node.js proxies. Includes visual ER diagram reverse/forward engineering.
